title: Portal to the Underworld
description: A woman in a flowing green dress stands in a decaying room marked with the number 391, reaching toward a shattered golden frame. Through the broken frame emerges a fiery orange portal containing a skeleton, while a winged angel in blue and orange robes protectively embraces two women on the right side of the scene.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene inside a crumbling gothic room with torn wallpaper and the number 391 on the wall. A woman in a long green dress reaches toward a shattered golden picture frame that reveals a fiery orange vortex portal with a skeleton emerging from it. On the right, a blue-winged angel with a halo embraces two women holding flowers. Bats fly near a dark cathedral in the fiery sky, transparent bubbles float throughout containing tiny scenes, white lilies grow from the floor, dramatic cinematic lighting.
